title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E1 — Doomed Decisions
Producers take the time to get to know dozens of inmates, following the action and watching the story unfold in from of their eyes.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E1 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Kenneth, Kentrell, Devon
For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next; 17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E4 — Jailhouse Blues
Before any inmate sees the inside of a prison, he has most likely first seen the inside of a jail; nothing about jail is for the faint of heart; for some, jail is the ultimate limbo between freedom and a life behind bars or even worse.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E1 — The Gang Investigators
From small towns to big cities, virtually every jail and prison in the United States deals with a gang problem; for some, suppressing gangs is a daily challenge that comes with life or death consequences.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E3 — A Brotherhood of Gangs
How gangs are managed in the jail system; how family relationships affect the jail experience.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Beat Down
A convicted sex offender becomes the victim of a brutal assault that leaves him unconscious and in the hospital; his assailants say the attack was warranted, but what they don't know might bring regret.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — 352,955 Days to Life
One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever; an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Taming Wild
A family man gets a decade in jail for manufacturing weapons; a meth addict gives up a prized possession; jail introduces both of these men to a cowboy, some wild horses and the opportunity of a lifetime.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Brothers
An inmate takes his fights from the street to the halls of the jail and his boyhood friend follows his example; two brothers turn to crime to support their habits and one faces the prospect of hitting the streets again.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — The Box Life
For inmates that reach their boiling point, the jail has a special place: The Box; as one inmate says, "separated from everything so you learn to deal with it. It's called 'The Box Life.'".

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Baptism by Fire
Inside Suffolk County Jail, one inmate finds himself on the wrong end of a vicious attack; another, with a reputation for violence, keeps the staff on constant alert; a young man with a bright future awaits trial for first-degree murder.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Bad Rep
A man accused of possessing child porn tries to salvage his relationship with his daughter and her children; deputies contend with an inmate on a mission.

title: Lockup: Pendleton: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Everyone's Got Baggage
Pendleton Juvenile is the last stop in Indiana for young offenders who have committed serious crimes; the staff there must always be prepared for the unexpected, and is determined to rehabilitate impulsive teens who are often angry and violent.

title: Lockup: Pendleton: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Under Pressure
A maximum-security prison is responsible for educating and rehabilitating teenage gang members, sex offenders and juveniles with mental health issues; inside the razor wire fences, anything can happen, and some days are more chaotic than others.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E2 — Unraveling the Truth
Additional footage from the "Lockup" series.
